title: [GB] Fix reverse charge VAT sales posting
summary: GB reverse-charge VAT sales posting now correctly handles zero-quantity lines and uses line-based applicability checks instead of header-copied state, with legacy item validation isolated behind the feature flag.
key_points: Fixed reverse-charge calculation to skip zero-quantity sales lines during posting
Changed applicability checks to read from the sales line's posting state rather than a copied header
Isolated legacy item flag validation behind the reverse-charge feature status to preserve backward compatibility
Added eight regression test scenarios covering feature states, conflicting setups, partial invoicing, thresholds, and edge cases
quote: Sales posting still validates legacy item flags, preventing items configured only for GB reverse charge from posting.
